name: speculum-sidecar-refactor
description: Speculum sidecar refactor — gRPC host over BrowserSession

scripts.build: npm run build:page-projection && npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc
scripts.lab:projection: npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc && node dist/browser/mirror/projection/lab/host/index.js
scripts.lab:iframe-open: npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc && node scripts/lab-iframe-open-ui.js
scripts.lab:shadow-closed: npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc && node scripts/lab-shadow-closed-ui.js
scripts.lab:eneba-turnstile: npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc && node scripts/lab-eneba-turnstile-ui.js
scripts.lab:turnstile-sheet-dump: npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc && node scripts/lab-turnstile-sheet-dump.js
scripts.smoke:projection-lab: npm run check:page-projection-boundaries && npm run build:virtual && npm run build:lab-client && npm run build:snapshot && tsc && node scripts/smoke-projection-lab.js
scripts.unit: npm run check:page-projection-boundaries && npm run build && node dist/unit.js
